material_master: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production medieval game material master sheet, flat orthographic texture samples for UV mapping onto low-poly buildings. Create a precise 3-column by 2-row grid of SIX equal square texture panels, edge-to-edge, no margins, no labels, no borders, no objects or perspective. Top left: warm honey-grey limestone wall, squared irregular hand-cut blocks, roughly 5 courses, subtle aged mortar and chips. Top middle: pale warm ochre lime plaster, gentle weathering and small cracks, mostly intact, no bricks showing. Top right: weathered dark charcoal slate roof, 9 orderly horizontal overlapping courses, restrained olive lichen. Bottom left: dark honey-brown aged oak boards running vertically, approximately 7 boards, restrained grain, joints, no hardware. Bottom middle: worn pale limestone street paving, irregular broad rectangular flagstones, slight dark moss only in narrow joints, top-down view. Bottom right: pale warm limestone close surface, fine stone grain and subtle chips, no block divisions, for sculpted arch voussoirs. Style: carefully hand-painted old-school fantasy dungeon game textures, rich fine detail, restrained contrast, diffuse neutral lighting, no cast shadows or shiny highlights. Each panel is uniform usable material to its edges; no vignette, no gradient lighting. Coherent warm stone/plaster against dark roof/oak, cared-for old sanctuary town. High resolution landscape 3:2 sheet with sharp detailed brushwork. No text, watermark, vegetation objects, doors or windows.
